narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.08 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 628.54-636.48 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 638.70; the first objective pays 1.29R at 625.67.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 638.70 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 28/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering
